text:
josie: Heads up: deploy-bot raised a critical rule during the midnight change window. Release notes for v8.0.0 advertise a migration hook (`--run-db-migrations`) but the binary exits with unknown subcommand.

deploy-bot: Safety alert fired: RN-210_release_notes_migration_mismatch. Severity: high. Suggested actions: pause rollout, immediate rollback to v7.9.12, or block traffic and ship hotpatch. Note: potential data-inconsistency risk if customers unknowingly trigger migration.

ops-sam: Yikes. Any evidence of migrations running in prod?

nora: No customer reports, but QA saw a canary where the service printed: `Error: unknown command 'run-db-migrations'` and then restarted. Also saw a partially-applied schema check in logs (failed).

pm-rahul: If a customer runs the advertised command and it silently fails, that's bad. We shouldn't risk fragmentation where some customers can run a migration and others can't. Rollback seems safer.

support-zoe: I'll prep an urgent CSM note: "We paused tonight's rollout after identifying a documentation/binary mismatch that could affect migrations; we are rolling back to stable and will update once patched."

legal-micah: Also flag for regulatory: any customer data migration footnote should be included in the audit trail. If we ship with mismatched docs it could be a compliance issue. Recommend rollback.

deploy-bot: Auto-rollback thresholds: error spike >2x baseline for 5m OR data-consistency alarms (dc-guard) trigger. Current telemetry: error spike within noise, dc-guard not triggered yet. Still recommends human decision due to migration exposure.

ops-sam: Operational times: rollback to v7.9.12 estimated 12-20m (traffic-pin + rollback), hotpatch path ~50-80m (branch, reinstate CLI handler, test migration dry-run in staging, then release). Given migration risk, I'll execute rollback if we all agree.

josie: I agree with rollback. We can't assume customers will avoid running the CLI. Also simplifies incident comms.

pm-rahul: Confirming rollback. After rollback, we'll cut a hotfix v8.0.1 that adds a migration CLI test and ties release notes to built artifacts. Also add a changelog gate so docs edits referencing migrations must link to binary artifact (ticket RN-211).

ops-sam: Running commands now: `deployctl pause --release v8.0.0` -> paused. `deployctl traffic pin --to v7.9.12 --percent 100` -> applying.

ops-sam: Pin applied. Rolling back live canary traffic. Starting rollback job `rollbackctl start --from v8.0.0 --to v7.9.12 --reason "migration-doc-mismatch"`. ETA ~15m.

deploy-bot: Rollback job in progress. Notifying on-call and incident channel.

support-zoe: Sent internal CSM message and created public-safe blurb template for later.

ops-sam: Rollback completed. All traffic on v7.9.12. Health checks green. :white_check_mark:

nora: Post-rollback: staging reproduction shows missing CLI handler; hotfix branch created to reintroduce handler and add a dry-run migration test.

pm-rahul: We'll schedule a quiet-window redeploy once hotfix is baked. Legal-micah, please keep the changelog audit note.

legal-micah: Will add a footnote and retain the original changelog + revert in the audit trail. Also request a short incident blurb for compliance.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Release v8.0.0 marked as rolled back; recommendation: block auto-promotion until RN-211 is implemented.

josie: Thanks all. Follow-ups: RN-211 (changelog gate), RN-212 (CI migration-dryrun test), and an ops runbook addendum for migration-related release notes. Closing thread once hotfix passes staging smoke.
